chain.text:
**Facility**
60-cm reflector (2017); 20-cm refractor for outreach.
195 useful nights/year average; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn).

**Data**
~400 GB/month; nightly transfer to Marseille server, 40 minutes.

**Instrument**
Main camera replaced March 2025; 30% lower read noise.
Firmware update pending; needs one full night offline.

**Incidents**
2023: dome motor seized, telescope hit wall, counterweight rod bent; rod replaced, limit switch added.
Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; now GPS-checked each session.

**Rules**
No runs during outreach evenings.
Raw frames never deleted; compressed after two years.
Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Open item**
Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration: shared scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity unknown.
